description: Retrieve one PCC catalog entry by its id, e.g. engine, stream, meter. Read-only; returns the entry's name, price, notes, and links. Use when you know the exact entry id; use pcc_search to find an id by keyword. An unknown id returns an error listing the known ids.

id.description: Entry id within the PCC catalog, e.g. engine, stream, meter. Get the id list from pcc_search with an empty query; an unknown id returns an error listing the known ids.

name: pcc_get
